# Codemap readiness observer reference

These fixtures execute the original coordinator policy, ownership, demand, ticket, wait and release bodies from RPCE revision `43a9c29d3894e4841d8cca4c75b45f7a68b3ecb3`, plus the original Store completion latch. `provenance.json` identifies every source range and its hash. Extracted source is literal data in `original-bodies.swift.txt`; the generator combines it with `adapter.swift` in a temporary Swift executable. `store-reference-only.swift.txt` contains uncompiled Store excerpts for comparison.

Run `node test/fixtures/rpce-readiness-observer/generate.mjs /absolute/path/to/repoprompt-ce` to regenerate, or append `--check` for a byte-for-byte check. Generation requires the pinned checkout, Node, Swift and `trash`. The production allowance is 10000 ms. The pending reference cases inject a 50 ms policy into the same original algorithm. Public smip regressions use the production allowance; a fixture gate opens after two readiness windows so a regressed join fails instead of hanging.

The original loop returns ready completion or pending status at its readiness deadline. With an independent retainer, presentation release returns while the underlying work remains incomplete. Store request/status/retention behavior is modeled; original Store cancellation and engine cleanup are not executed. The fixture establishes neither an end-to-end MCP duration limit nor matching, currentness, busy/retry, freezing or app behavior. `test/codemap-demand.test.ts` separately checks real native acquisition, observer release, independent ownership, delayed rendering and later packet verification on macOS and Linux.
